a16z-kalshi:ashbyhq:5f980066-258e-41cd-8.description: WHAT IS KALSHI? Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. - Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. - Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. ROLE ROADMAP We're looking for a Motion Designer to own motion across both our brand and product. On the brand side that means campaigns, social, launches, and ads. On the product side it means UI animation, micro-interactions, onboarding flows, and the motion design system that keeps everything consistent. You'll work closely with design, product, and marketing and have end-to-end ownership over how Kalshi uses motion, from concept through engineering handoff. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design and produce motion content for Kalshi's brand: social, campaigns, product launches, ads, and anything else that needs to move - Own in-app animation and interaction design: micro-interactions, onboarding flows, loading states, transitions, and UI motion that makes the product feel polished and intentional - Build and export production-ready animations for engineering using Lottie and other handoff formats - Develop and maintain Kalshi's motion language, creating a system of timing, easing, and animation principles that keep everything consistent across brand and product - Collaborate with product designers and engineers to ensure motion is implemented accurately and performantly - Concept and execute motion work independently from brief to final delivery WHAT YOU BRING - A portfolio that shows range, ideally including both brand motion and product/UI animation - Strong design sensibility across timing, easing, typography, and composition - Ability to work across two very different contexts (expressive brand work and functional product motion) without conflating the two - Comfortable owning work end-to-end with minimal direction - Experience collaborating with engineers on animation implementation NYC PAY TRANSPARENCY DISCLOSURE Salary Range: $180,000 to $300,000 annually plus equity and benefits. This salary range is based on the current available market data, and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to further discuss. OUR CULTURE Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets. Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1. COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration

Growth 전략 및 실행 리딩 브랜드 성장을 위한 프로모션, 광고, 운영 개선 전략 기획 및 실행 브랜드별 특성과 문제 유형에 맞는 Growth playbook 설계 신규 프로그램 및 테스트를 직접 기획하고 성과 검증 리딩 검증된 Best Practice를 구조화하여 조직 내 확산 3. 운영 프로세스 및 성과 개선 주문 운영, 광고 운영, 입점/노출 구조 등 운영 프로세스 개선 과제 수행 운영 bottleneck 및 비효율을 발견하고 개선안 도출 반복적으로 발생하는 이슈를 표준화 및 프로세스화하여 개선 운영 품질, Completion, 생산성 등 핵심 KPI 기반 성과 관리 4. 데이터 기반 의사결정 및 프로젝트 리딩 SQL 등을 활용하여 데이터를 직접 추출·분석하고 인사이트 도출 Funnel, 광고 효율, 유입/리텐션 등 주요 지표 모니터링 및 리뷰 AM, Product, Marketing 등과 협업하여 프로젝트 end-to-end 리딩 복잡한 이해관계 속에서 실행 과제를 ownership 가지고 결과까지 연결 자격 요건 10년 이상의 사업 전략, 운영, Growth, 컨설팅 또는 유관 경력 데이터를 기반으로 문제를 정의하고 실제 성과를 만들어본 경험 SQL을 활용하여 데이터를 직접 추출·분석한 경험 복잡한 프로젝트를 end-to-end로 리딩한 경험 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 여러 이해관계자와 협업한 경험 우대 사항 플랫폼, O2O, 이커머스, 물류 등 운영 중심 비즈니스 경험 Growth, 운영 개선, 프로세스 고도화 경험 광고/프로모션 기반 성과 개선 경험 Looker, Tableau 등 BI 도구 활용 경험 신규 서비스 또는 프로세스를 직접 기획·런칭한 경험 전형 절차 및 안내 사항 전형절차 • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격 • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다. • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다. 참고사항 • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다. • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다. • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다. • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다. • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다. • (리쿠르터 노트: 정규직인 경우 추가) 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다. 개인정보 처리방침 • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/ 서류반환정책 1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것입니다. 2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다. 3. 위 2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제3호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com)로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다. 4. 당사는 위 2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다. 5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

balderton-zego:workable:d53f49562d.description: About us At Zego, we know that traditional motor insurance holds good drivers back. It’s too complicated, too expensive, and it doesn't take into account how well you actually drive. That’s why, since 2016, we’ve been on a mission to change all of that. Our mission at Zego is to offer the lowest priced insurance for good drivers. From van drivers and gig workers to everyday car drivers, our customers are our driving force - they’re at the heart of everything we do. We’ve sold tens of millions of policies so far, and raised over $200 million in funding. And we’re only just getting started. About the role We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead one to two of Zego’s core technology teams. Each of your teams will comprise 6–8 engineers, including a Tech Lead, and play a key role in how we build and deliver impactful technology. You’ll lead a team working on one of the most pivotal areas of our business – helping bring business and personal insurance to the Zego platform. The work sits at the heart of our product portfolio, and you’ll collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Data to drive initiatives that directly support Zego’s growth and expand our customer reach. This is not a hands-on coding role, but you’ll bring strong technical foundations and a background as a senior backend or frontend engineer. You’ll help shape technical direction alongside Tech Leads and Staff Engineers. You’ll also be supported by a broader community of engineering leaders and receive mentorship from Senior Engineering Managers, giving you the tools and coaching you need to grow as a people and delivery leader. This role is ideal for someone who has been an Engineering Manager for 1–3 years, is looking to take the next step in their leadership journey, and wants to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth product environment. What you will be doing Lead and support one or two teams of 6–8 engineers in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. The size of your scope will depend on your prior experience. Drive engineering and operational excellence by setting high standards for system performance, quality, and maintainability. Influence architectural decisions in partnership with Tech Leads and Staff Engineers. Own delivery outcomes and collaborate with Product, Data, and Marketing to shape objectives and align execution. Coach, mentor, and develop your team, helping engineers and Tech Leads grow their careers. Continuously improve ways of working, decision-making processes, and product team maturity. About you You've led a team before: You’ve been an Engineering Manager for 1–3 years and are confident in managing a team of 5–8 engineers, with a track record of growing individuals and shipping impactful products. You’re outcome-oriented: You focus on solving real user and business problems, not just shipping features. You help your team stay aligned to measurable goals and iterate effectively. You bring technical depth: You have a background in backend or frontend engineering and experience working with distributed systems. You bring credibility when engaging in technical discussions and reviews. You care about delivery: You take ownership of execution. You know when to escalate, unblock, and balance delivery speed with quality. You invest in engineering excellence: You promote solid design, thoughtful code, and sound decision-making. You help teams balance pragmatism with long-term thinking. You’re a confident people leader: You support growth through mentoring and development conversations, and you help build a high-performing, inclusive team culture. You give clear and constructive feedback: Whether celebrating great work or navigating tough conversations, you're comfortable giving feedback that’s timely, respectful, and focused on helping people grow. You’re a great communicator: You simplify complex topics for non-technical stakeholders and help cross-functional partners make good decisions quickly. You will be someone who’s actively curious
